items.title: Return signed Nutzungsvertrag
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns ein unterschriebenes Exemplar innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zurück; mitgezählt werden Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonntage und Feiertage.
items.computation: The letter itself defines 'Werktage' for this deadline as Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays, and sets the period running from the letter's own date, 2025-07-04 (a Friday). Starting the count the day after the document date (04.07 not counted, consistent with the usual §187 BGB rule) and counting 14 such Werktage forward, skipping Sundays (06.07, 13.07, 20.07) and checking for NRW public holidays (none fall in this period): day 1 = Sat 05.07, ... day 14 lands on Monday 21.07.2025. No weekend/holiday shift is needed afterward since the 14th Werktag itself is a Monday, a valid Werktag.

warnings: If the signed Nutzungsvertrag does not arrive by the stated deadline, the cooperative says it will reallocate the apartment to the next member on the waiting list, so returning it in good time is important.

The IBAN printed in the footer (DE57 3705 0198 0005 5539 00) is well-formed and belongs to a German bank, but this letter does not request any payment to it; no bank details should be used from this letter without separately confirming them.
